product.olivetti-m380t.summary: The professional M380 range with ten positions and ESDI or ST-506 disk options.
product.olivetti-m380t.history: The documentation places M380 T as the professional M380 range with ten positions and ESDI or ST-506 disk options.
product.olivetti-m380t.architecture: Memory organisation determines expansion options. The guide identifies BA814. All RAM resides on expansion boards.
product.olivetti-m380t.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 2.0 · PBZ6/PBZ7.
product.olivetti-m380t.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m380t.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m380t.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 8-1–8-2.
